title: 法兴银行：未来一周焦点是中国，AI板块能否修复？
speaker: Frank Benzimra

segments.en: Yeah, well first of all what we observe is if we look in the US first, the earnings season is very strong. Roughly for three upgrade we have one done great so that's quite a good ratio.
segments.zh: 首先，美国财报季非常强劲，每三个上调评级对应一个下调，比例不错。

segments.en: When it comes to Asia, the earnings season has just started. So what we've seen in the semiconductor business is that it's still pretty good actually. It's not giving any indication that there is a slowdown in the Capex.
segments.zh: 亚洲财报季刚刚开始。半导体业务表现仍然不错，没有迹象显示资本开支放缓。

segments.en: What we see as well in Korea we had few names where we could see from the automobile sector, we can feel a little bit of some competition from elsewhere. And what I'm really going to look at in the coming days in the coming week is China.
segments.zh: 韩国汽车板块感受到来自其他地区的竞争压力。未来一周我真正关注的是中国。

segments.en: What kind of earnings we are going to have, whether the consensus which is not too demanding is going to be to be beaten. And whether we can see this AI space which has been suffering in the recent period to recover. So this is I think the focus could be on China.
segments.zh: 财报能否超预期？近期承压的AI板块能否修复？我认为焦点应在中国。
